description: KMA Weather Data Service (기상자료개방포털) is a data repository run by Korea Meteorological Administration. The portal gives access to observed and forecast weather, typhoon, earthquake and climate statistics data of the administration as downloads and APIs with registration. Coverage: South Korea. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, api; access is free of charge with registration. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("기상자료개방포털") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support weather and hazard inputs for Korean infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
